summary: Completed comprehensive testing of KiKi Pentester PDF report enhancements and screenshot integration. All core features working correctly including tool names, test types, and screenshot evidence in PDF reports.

PDF report includes tool names for each vulnerability (HTTP Header Analyzer (HTTPX), CORS Policy Analyzer (HTTPX), etc.)
